normalIntro.cn: 围绕 fourth 的名次、占比与 forth 陷阱的五条记忆钩子。

normal.en: four + th = fourth: the th makes it a rank.
normal.cn: four 加 th 就是 fourth：th 让数字变成排名。

normal.en: Keep fourth (rank) apart from forth (forward, old style).
normal.cn: 区分 fourth（第四）与 forth（向前，旧式）。

normal.en: Say the date: the fourth of July.
normal.cn: 练习说日期：the fourth of July。

normal.en: A fourth of a pizza is one of four equal slices.
normal.cn: 比萨的 a fourth 是四等份中的一块。

normal.en: Finish fourth means just off the podium.
normal.cn: finish fourth 指名次正好差一步上领奖台。

abstract.en: Picture four lanes with the fourth lane marked.
abstract.cn: 想象画着标记的第四条跑道。

abstract.en: Picture a pizza cut into four equal wedges.
abstract.cn: 想象切成四等块的比萨。

abstract.en: Picture a scoreboard showing 1, 2, 3, then 4.
abstract.cn: 想象依次显示一、二、三、四的记分牌。

examples.en: Our class is on the fourth floor of the teaching building.
examples.cn: 我们班在教学楼四楼。

examples.en: Give me a fourth of the ribbon and keep the rest.
examples.cn: 给我四分之一条彩带，剩下的你留着。

examples.en: She finished fourth in the spelling contest.
examples.cn: 她在拼写比赛中得了第四名。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「佛思」——佛门弟子排队，第四位也想佛思（four+th）：fourth 就是队列里的第四。

root: fourth 出自古英语 feortha：feower（四）+ -tha（次序后缀）。中古英语经 ferthe 演变定型为 fourth。序数后缀 -th 为纯日耳曼构词成分，无拉丁来源。

sensesIntro.en: Fourth marks rank in series, share of a whole, and sports placements.
sensesIntro.cn: fourth 标记序列位次、整体占比与比赛名次。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: the fourth mark in a counted row
core.cn: 核心意象：数排里的第四个标记

branches.en: The position right after the third
branches.cn: 紧跟第三之后的位次

branches.en: Naming storey levels and dates
branches.cn: 命名楼层与日期

branches.en: One of four equal slices
branches.cn: 四等份中的一份

branches.en: The prize place below the podium
branches.cn: 领奖台之下的名次

branches.en: From list order to scoreboard order
branches.cn: 从列表位次到记分牌名次

intro.en: Fourth is a textbook example of the native ordinal suffix -th.
intro.cn: fourth 是本土序数后缀 -th 的教科书式示例。

latinIntro.en: No Latin root is involved; the family is wholly Germanic.
latinIntro.cn: 不涉及拉丁词根；词族完全是日耳曼的。

items.exampleCN: 与 fourth 同音不同词。

definition_zh: 自由的；空闲的；免费的；不受……影响的；释放；使自由
definition_en: not controlled, held, or paid for; having time available; to release someone or something
core_image: 敞开的笼门：锁住了的东西被放出去
scene: 公园免费开放日，孩子们不用买票就跑了进去。Entry to the park is free on Mondays.
sceneCN: 这里 free 是「免费的」的意思（第 3 个义项：不需要付钱）；周一进公园不用花钱。

derivatives.zh: free 加 -dom 名词后缀，义为「自由；自主」
free 加 -ly，义为「自由地；随意地」
free 加 -er，义为「释放者」
free 复合 man，义为「自由民；有公民权者」

senses.title: Not held or controlled
senses.definition: not held, tied, or controlled by anyone
senses.definitionCN: 没有被束缚或被他人支配的状态。
senses.example: The birds are free to fly where they like.
senses.exampleCN: 鸟儿可以自由地飞往任何地方。
senses.why: The Germanic root frijaz meant beloved, and being among your loved ones meant not being bound.
senses.whyCN: 日耳曼词根 frijaz 意为「亲爱的」，置身所爱之人中间便意味着不被束缚。

senses.title: Having free time
senses.definition: not busy; available to do something
senses.definitionCN: 没有安排、可以用于别处的时间。
senses.example: Are you free this Saturday afternoon?
senses.exampleCN: 你这周六下午有空吗？
senses.why: Not being tied by duties leaves time unbound.
senses.whyCN: 不被事务捆绑，时间便是「未被占用」的。

senses.title: Costing no money
senses.definition: available without payment
senses.definitionCN: 不需要付钱就能获得。
senses.example: Water is free at the school canteen.
senses.exampleCN: 学校食堂的水是免费的。
senses.why: Free of ties becomes free of payment: nothing holds your money.
senses.whyCN: 「不被束缚」延伸到金钱：你的钱没有被「拴走」。

senses.title: Not affected by something bad
senses.definition: not containing or affected by something unwanted
senses.definitionCN: 没有不需要的东西、不受其影响的。
senses.example: The room is free of smoke after the window was opened.
senses.exampleCN: 开窗后房间里没有烟味了。
senses.why: Freedom from something means it cannot reach you.
senses.whyCN: free from 某物，即该物够不到你。

senses.title: To release from holding
senses.definition: to let a person or animal go from a cage, trap, or hold
senses.definitionCN: 把人或动物从笼子、陷阱、控制中放开。
senses.example: Firemen freed the cat from the tall tree.
senses.exampleCN: 消防员把猫从高树上救了下来。
senses.why: The state of being free becomes the act of freeing.
senses.whyCN: 「自由的状态」转为「给自由」的动作。

intro.en: Free carries a warm old meaning: beloved membership, not chains.
intro.cn: free 携带着温暖的古义：「被爱者」的身份，而非「没有锁链」的字面。

items.en: The reconstructed root *frijaz meant beloved, related to friend.
items.cn: 重构词根 *frijaz 意为「亲爱的」，与 friend 同源。

items.en: In early tribes, household members were the free, unenslaved ones.
items.cn: 早期部族中，家庭成员即是「自由人」，区别于奴隶。

items.en: Fre meant free, contrasting with theow (slave).
items.cn: 古英语 fre 意为自由，与 theow（奴隶）相对。

items.en: The senses of free time, no cost, and release all spread.
items.cn: 空闲、免费、释放诸义扩散开来。

items.en: Freedom, freely, and compounds like free of charge became fixed.
items.cn: freedom、freely 及 free of charge 等搭配定型。

note.en: Words shaped like free and words of liberty and release.
note.cn: 与 free 形近的词以及表示自由、释放的词。

entries.definition: the noun built on free
entries.definitionCN: 自由；free 的名词派生。

entries.definition: to turn into ice; differs from free by one letter
entries.definitionCN: 结冰；与 free 仅差一个字母，注意区分。

entries.definition: to run away; shares three letters with free
entries.definitionCN: 逃离；与 free 字母相近，词义相关而不同。

entries.definition: freedom from control, often in law and politics
entries.definitionCN: 自由（正式用法，多用于法律与政治）。

entries.definition: to let go of something held
entries.definitionCN: 释放；与 free 的动词义近义。

entries.definition: not busy or taken
entries.definitionCN: 空着的；与 free 的空闲义近义。

normalIntro.en: Five hooks on the beloved-root origin and the main uses of free.
normalIntro.cn: 围绕「被爱」词源与 free 主要用法的五条记忆钩子。

normal.en: Free and friend share a root: beloved people are free people.
normal.cn: free 与 friend 同根：被爱的人就是自由人。

normal.en: Free time is time not tied up by duties.
normal.cn: free time 就是不被事务捆住的时间。

normal.en: Free of charge means your money stays free too.
normal.cn: free of charge：钱也保持「自由」，不用付。

normal.en: Free from something means that thing cannot reach you.
normal.cn: free from 某物＝它够不到你。

normal.en: As a verb, free opens the cage: freed, freeing.
normal.cn: 动词 free 是「开笼」的动作：freed、freeing。

abstract.en: Picture a cage door swinging wide.
abstract.cn: 想象笼门敞开的那一刻。

abstract.en: Picture a kite string let go into the wind.
abstract.cn: 想象风筝线松手后随风远去。

abstract.en: Picture an empty afternoon with no plans.
abstract.cn: 想象一个没有任何安排的空下午。

examples.en: The museum offers free entry for students.
examples.cn: 博物馆对学生免费开放。

examples.en: The zoo keepers freed the trapped monkey safely.
examples.cn: 动物园饲养员安全地救出了被困的猴子。

examples.en: I am free after four o'clock if you want to play chess.
examples.cn: 四点以后我有空，如果你想下棋的话。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「福瑞」——福气瑞气包围着你，无拘无束：free 就是「被福气围住」的自在。

root: free 出自日耳曼重构词根 *frijaz（亲爱的），与 friend 同源。古英语 fre 与 theow（奴隶）相对——「家内所爱者」即「不被束缚者」。核心意象始终是「无锁」：自由、空闲、免费、免于，皆为同一意象的四个切面。

sensesIntro.en: Free spreads from not being held to spare time, no cost, immunity, and the act of releasing.
sensesIntro.cn: free 从「不被束缚」铺开：空闲时间、零费用、免受影响，最后变成「释放」的动作。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: an open gate with no lock
core.cn: 核心意象：一扇没有锁的门

branches.en: Not held by chains or owners
branches.cn: 不被锁链或主人束缚

branches.en: Time unbound by duties
branches.cn: 不被事务捆住的时间

branches.en: Money unbound by payment
branches.cn: 不被付款拴住的钱

branches.en: Bad things cannot reach in
branches.cn: 坏事够不着的隔绝状态

branches.en: From being free to setting free
branches.cn: 从「处于自由」到「给予自由」

intro.en: Free is a short Germanic root that still builds new words every day.
intro.cn: free 是个短小的日耳曼词根，至今仍在新造词中活跃。

latinIntro.en: The root is Germanic, not Latin; Latin-based liberty is the borrowing counterpart.
latinIntro.cn: 词根属日耳曼而非拉丁；拉丁来源的 liberty 是它的书面对应词。

items.example: The dog ran free in the park.
The city granted him freeman status.
Bikes are free of charge here.
The statue holds a torch of liberty.
items.exampleCN: 与 free 对照的借词。

definition_zh: 自由；自主；自由权；不受……约束的状态
definition_en: the state of being free; the right to act, speak, or think as one wants
core_image: 打开的鸟笼：翅膀终于属于天空
scene: 毕业典礼上，校长寄语毕业生学会为自己的选择负责。Freedom comes with responsibility.
sceneCN: 这里 freedom 是「自由（须承担责任）」的意思（第 1 个义项：自主的状态）；校长提醒学生自由与责任同行。

derivatives.zh: freedom 的词根形容词，义为「自由的；免费的」
free 加 -ly，义为「自由地」
复合形容词，义为「热爱自由的」

senses.title: The state of being free
senses.definition: the condition of not being imprisoned, controlled, or restricted
senses.definitionCN: 不被关押、不受控制、不受限制的状态。
senses.example: The animals enjoy freedom in the wide reserve.
senses.exampleCN: 动物们在广袤的保护区内自由生活。
senses.why: The suffix -dom turns the adjective free into the state of being free.
senses.whyCN: 后缀 -dom 把形容词 free 变成「处于自由」的状态名词。

senses.title: The right to do something
senses.definition: the legal or moral right to act, speak, or think in a certain way
senses.definitionCN: 以某种方式行动、发言或思考的法律或道义权利。
senses.example: Freedom of speech is written in the constitution.
senses.exampleCN: 言论自由写进了宪法。
senses.why: The state of freedom becomes a protected right.
senses.whyCN: 自由的状态被制度保护为权利。

senses.title: Not being affected by something unwanted
senses.definition: the state of not being affected by something unpleasant
senses.definitionCN: 不受不愉快事物影响的状态。
senses.example: The village enjoys freedom from traffic noise.
senses.exampleCN: 这个村庄没有交通噪音的困扰。
senses.why: Freedom from a thing means the thing is kept out.
senses.whyCN: freedom from 某物，即该物被挡在外面。

intro.en: Freedom is a native build: free plus the state suffix -dom.
intro.cn: freedom 是本土构词：free 加状态后缀 -dom。

items.en: Freodoms roots are freo (free) and the suffix -dom.
items.cn: freedom 的根基是古英语 freo（自由）与后缀 -dom。

items.en: -dom meant judgment, state, or domain, as in kingdom.
items.cn: -dom 意为裁决、状态、领域，见于 kingdom。

items.en: Freodom first meant the state of being a free person.
items.cn: freodom 最初指「作为自由人的身份状态」。

items.en: The word widened to rights and liberties in law and religion.
items.cn: 该词在法律与宗教语境扩展到权利与自由。

items.en: Fixed phrases like freedom of speech became pillars of public language.
items.cn: freedom of speech 等固定搭配成为公共语言支柱。

note.en: Words shaped like freedom and words about rights and release.
note.cn: 与 freedom 形近的词及关于权利、释放的词。

entries.definition: very cold; different root from freedom
entries.definitionCN: 极冷的；与 freedom 无词源关系，仅拼写相近。

entries.definition: a state ruled by a king; shares the -dom suffix
entries.definitionCN: 王国；与 freedom 共享 -dom 后缀。

entries.definition: the state of being bored; another -dom state noun
entries.definitionCN: 无聊；又一个 -dom 状态名词。

entries.definition: freedom from control, often legal
entries.definitionCN: 自由（正式，偏法律语境）。

entries.definition: not depending on others
entries.definitionCN: 独立；强调不依赖。

entries.definition: self-rule of a person or region
entries.definitionCN: 自治；自主权；学术与政治用语。

normalIntro.en: Five hooks on the -dom state suffix and freedom's public uses.
normalIntro.cn: 围绕 -dom 状态后缀与 freedom 公共用法的五条记忆钩子。

normal.en: Break freedom into free + dom: the state of being free.
normal.cn: 拆分 free + dom：处于自由的状态。

normal.en: Compare the -dom family: freedom, kingdom, boredom.
normal.cn: 对比 -dom 词族：freedom、kingdom、boredom。

normal.en: Learn the big three rights: freedom of speech, choice, movement.
normal.cn: 记三大自由：言论、选择、行动。

normal.en: Freedom from fear keeps the bad thing outside the door.
normal.cn: freedom from fear 是把恐惧挡在门外。

normal.en: Freedom comes with responsibility: the gate opens both ways.
normal.cn: 自由伴随责任：门是双向的。

abstract.en: Picture an open birdcage against a wide sky.
abstract.cn: 想象辽阔天空下敞开的鸟笼。

abstract.en: Picture a document signing away old restrictions.
abstract.cn: 想象一份解除旧限制的文书。

abstract.en: Picture a hilltop where the whole valley is visible.
abstract.cn: 想象能望见整片山谷的山顶。

examples.en: The refugees finally found freedom in a new country.
examples.cn: 难民们终于在新的国家获得了自由。

examples.en: With a bicycle comes the freedom to explore the whole town.
examples.cn: 有了自行车，就拥有了探索全城的自由。

examples.en: The report calls for freedom from hunger for every child.
examples.cn: 报告呼吁让每个孩子免于饥饿。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「福瑞等」——福气瑞气等在门外等你走出来：freedom 就是门外的自由在等你。

root: freedom 为古英语本土复合词：freo（自由，词根 *frijaz「亲爱的」）+ -dom（状态、领域后缀，见 kingdom）。字面即「自由之状态域」；与 free、friend 构成同根家族。

sensesIntro.en: Freedom names the state of being free, the rights that protect it, and immunity from harm.
sensesIntro.cn: freedom 命名自由的状态、保护它的权利，以及免受伤害的安定。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: the open sky beyond the cage door
core.cn: 核心意象：笼门之外的整片天空

branches.en: Living without control or prison
branches.cn: 不受控制、不被关押地生活

branches.en: Speech and choice protected by law
branches.cn: 受法律保护的言论与选择权

branches.en: Rights enjoyed together by citizens
branches.cn: 公民共同享有的自由权

branches.en: Keeping fear, noise, or hunger outside
branches.cn: 把恐惧、噪音、饥饿挡在门外

branches.en: Freedom is both open gates and solid walls
branches.cn: 自由既是敞开的门，也是结实的墙

intro.en: Freedom is built with the state suffix -dom on the adjective free.
intro.cn: freedom 用状态后缀 -dom 附加在形容词 free 上构成。

latinIntro.en: The build is native Germanic; Latin liberty is the parallel borrowing.
latinIntro.cn: 构词属本土日耳曼；拉丁借词 liberty 是它的平行对应。

definition_zh: 结冰；冻结；冷冻；使结冰；（因恐惧）呆住；冻结（资产、价格）
definition_en: to become or make something hard with cold; to stop moving or stay still from fear
core_image: 水在一夜寒风里骤然定住：流动被按了暂停键
scene: 冬夜过后，清晨的池塘铺上了一层薄冰，鸭子的爪印都印在冰面上。The pond began to freeze during the cold night.
sceneCN: 这里 freeze 是「结冰」的意思（第 1 个义项：液体因低温变硬）；寒夜里池塘水面开始冻结。

derivatives.zh: freeze 加 -er，义为「冰柜；冷冻箱」
现在分词作形容词，义为「极冷的；冰点以下的」
过去分词作形容词，义为「冰冻的；冷冻的」
anti- + freeze，义为「防冻液」

senses.title: To become hard with cold
senses.definition: to turn from liquid into ice at or below zero degrees
senses.definitionCN: 液体在零度或以下变成冰。
senses.example: The river freezes in December every year.
senses.exampleCN: 这条河每年十二月结冰。
senses.why: The Germanic root freusan meant to burn cold, an image of cold striking like fire.
senses.whyCN: 日耳曼词根 freusan 意为「被寒冷灼伤」，把严寒比作火。

senses.title: To make food very cold for keeping
senses.definition: to put food in a freezer to keep it fresh
senses.definitionCN: 把食物放进冰柜低温保存。
senses.example: Mum froze the extra dumplings for next week.
senses.exampleCN: 妈妈把多余的饺子冻起来下周吃。
senses.why: Stopping time for food by stopping its movement.
senses.whyCN: 让食物停止流动，从而停止「变质的时间」。

senses.title: To stop moving from fear or shock
senses.definition: to suddenly stop moving because of fear, shock, or surprise
senses.definitionCN: 因恐惧、震惊而突然停止动作。
senses.example: The rabbit froze in the headlights.
senses.exampleCN: 兔子在车灯下僵住了。
senses.why: Cold strikes a person and body stops like frozen water.
senses.whyCN: 寒冷袭人，身体像冻住的水一样静止。

senses.title: To fix prices or money in place
senses.definition: to officially stop prices, wages, or accounts from changing
senses.definitionCN: 官方停止价格、工资或账户的变动。
senses.example: The city froze bus fares for two years.
senses.exampleCN: 该市把公交票价冻结了两年。
senses.why: Social numbers stop moving just like water in ice.
senses.whyCN: 社会的数字像冰中的水一样停止流动。

intro.en: Freeze comes from an old Germanic root that described cold as a kind of burning.
intro.cn: freeze 出自一个古老的日耳曼词根，它把严寒描述为一种「灼烧」。

items.en: The reconstructed root *freusan meant to burn with cold, shared with frost.
items.cn: 重构词根 *freusan 意为「被寒冷灼伤」，与 frost 同源。

items.en: Freosan meant to congeal or turn into ice.
items.cn: 古英语 freosan 意为凝固、变成冰。

items.en: The frost family kept the root in weather words.
items.cn: frost 一族在气象词中保留了该词根。

items.en: The strong verb forms froze and frozen settled down.
items.cn: 强变化动词形式 froze、frozen 定型。

items.en: Food freezing, financial freezing, and the fear sense all became common.
items.cn: 食品冷冻、金融冻结与恐惧义都在现代英语中普及。

note.en: Words shaped like freeze and words of cold and stillness.
note.cn: 与 freeze 形近的词及表示寒冷、静止的词。

entries.definition: the verb form of free; one letter from freeze
entries.definitionCN: free 的三单形式；与 freeze 仅差一个字母。

entries.definition: thin ice formed on surfaces; shares the Germanic root
entries.definitionCN: 霜；与 freeze 同出日耳曼词根。

entries.definition: a light wind; rhymes with freeze
entries.definitionCN: 微风；与 freeze 押韵，词义无关。

entries.definition: to make cold but not frozen
entries.definitionCN: 使变凉；不到结冰的程度。

entries.definition: to cover with a layer of ice
entries.definitionCN: 结冰覆盖；与 freeze over 近义。

entries.definition: to stop moving and become rigid
entries.definitionCN: 变僵硬；与 freeze 的呆住义近义。

normalIntro.en: Five hooks on cold, time-stopping, and the fear sense of freeze.
normalIntro.cn: 围绕寒冷、时间暂停与恐惧义的五条记忆钩子。

normal.en: Water freezes at zero degrees: the flow stops.
normal.cn: 水在零度结冰：流动停止。

normal.en: Freeze, froze, frozen: a strong verb with an o-family.
normal.cn: freeze 的强变化：freeze、froze、frozen。

normal.en: A freezer keeps food by freezing time for it.
normal.cn: 冰柜靠冻结时间来保鲜。

normal.en: Fear freezes bodies as winter freezes rivers.
normal.cn: 恐惧冻结身体，如同寒冬冻结河流。

normal.en: Frost and freeze share the same old root of burning cold.
normal.cn: frost 与 freeze 同根，都指「灼人的冷」。

abstract.en: Picture a lake stopping mid-wave overnight.
abstract.cn: 想象湖面在夜里的波浪半途凝住。

abstract.en: Picture a rabbit rooted still in car lights.
abstract.cn: 想象车灯下僵立不动的兔子。

abstract.en: Picture a price tag nailed to the shelf for two years.
abstract.cn: 想象被钉在货架上两年的价签。

examples.en: The lake froze hard enough to skate on.
examples.cn: 湖面冻得可以滑冰了。

examples.en: She froze when the teacher asked her a surprise question.
examples.cn: 老师突然提问时她一下子呆住了。

examples.en: Frozen peas taste almost as fresh as garden peas.
examples.cn: 冷冻豌豆尝起来几乎和新鲜的差不多。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「福瑞兹」——福气瑞气都冻住了，一动不动：freeze 就是万物被按下的暂停键。

root: freeze 出自日耳曼重构词根 *freusan（被寒冷灼伤），与 frost 同源；古英语 freosan 意为「凝固成冰」。强变化动词（freeze-froze-frozen）。核心意象是「流动停止」：水冻、人僵、价冻结共用一根。

sensesIntro.en: Freeze stops moving water, food time, startled bodies, and changing prices.
sensesIntro.cn: freeze 让流动的水、食物的时间、受惊的身体、变动的价格一并停住。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a flowing thing suddenly held still
core.cn: 核心意象：流动之物骤然定住

branches.en: Liquids harden into ice
branches.cn: 液体变硬成冰

branches.en: Food time suspended in the freezer
branches.cn: 食物时间在冰柜中被暂停

branches.en: A startled body goes still
branches.cn: 受惊的身体僵住不动

branches.en: Prices and wages held in place
branches.cn: 价格与工资被钉在原地

branches.en: Stopping flow keeps things from spoiling
branches.cn: 止住流动使事物免于变坏

intro.en: Freeze heads a Germanic cold family rather than a Latin one.
intro.cn: freeze 统领的是日耳曼「寒冷家族」，而非拉丁词族。

latinIntro.en: The root *freusan links freeze and frost; Latin cooling words are separate borrowings.
latinIntro.cn: 词根 *freusan 连接 freeze 与 frost；拉丁冷却词是独立的借入成分。

items.example: Put the meat in the freezer.
A frigid wind blew all day.

definition_zh: 新鲜的；清新的；新的；淡的（水）；精神饱满的
definition_en: newly made, picked, or arrived; clean and cool; not salty; full of energy
core_image: 清晨刚摘的苹果还挂着露水：刚离开枝头的鲜活
scene: 早市上，农民把今天凌晨刚摘的蔬菜摆上摊位。The market sells fresh vegetables every morning.
sceneCN: 这里 fresh 是「新鲜的」的意思（第 1 个义项：刚产出、未变质）；菜摊上的蔬菜都是当天凌晨现摘的。

derivatives.zh: fresh 加 -en，义为「使新鲜；使变凉」
freshen 加 -er，义为「清新剂」
fresh 加 -ly，义为「刚刚；新近」
re- + fresh，义为「使恢复精神；刷新」

senses.title: Recently made, picked, or cooked
senses.definition: produced or picked recently and not spoiled or preserved
senses.definitionCN: 刚产出不久、未变质或未经保存处理的。
senses.example: Fresh bread smells wonderful in the morning.
senses.exampleCN: 清晨的面包香气扑鼻。
senses.why: The root names dew or juice, the wet sign of life just picked.
senses.whyCN: 词根本指露水或汁液——刚摘下的东西带湿气，那是鲜活之证。

senses.title: Clean, cool, and pleasant
senses.definition: clean, cool, and pleasantly different
senses.definitionCN: 干净、凉爽、令人舒爽的。
senses.example: Open the window and let in some fresh air.
senses.exampleCN: 打开窗户，让新鲜空气进来。
senses.why: Just-picked qualities extend to breezes and starts.
senses.whyCN: 「刚摘下」的质感延伸到风与开端。

senses.title: Not salty
senses.definition: not containing salt, used of water
senses.definitionCN: 指水不含盐分。
senses.example: The lake is the region's main fresh water source.
senses.exampleCN: 这个湖是该地区主要的淡水来源。
senses.why: Untouched water from rivers has not met the sea's salt.
senses.whyCN: 河流里的水未与海水的盐相遇。

senses.title: Full of energy; not tired
senses.definition: having a lot of energy and not being tired
senses.definitionCN: 精力充沛、尚未疲劳的状态。
senses.example: After a good sleep, she felt fresh again.
senses.exampleCN: 好好睡了一觉后，她又精神焕发了。
senses.why: Restored energy feels like a new-picked state.
senses.whyCN: 恢复的精力如同「刚摘下」的鲜活。

intro.en: Fresh comes from a Germanic root tied to dew and juice, the wet marks of life.
intro.cn: fresh 出自一个与露水、汁液相关的日耳曼词根——那是生命的湿润印记。

items.en: The reconstructed root *friskaz meant fresh or lively, related to dew.
items.cn: 重构词根 *friskaz 意为新鲜的、有活力的，与露水相关。

items.en: Fersc meant fresh, untainted, or not salty, already covering water.
items.cn: 古英语 fersc 意为新鲜的、未变质的、不咸的，已涵盖淡水义。

items.en: The related form friskr strengthened the lively sense.
items.cn: 古诺斯语相关形式 friskr 强化了「有活力」义。

items.en: The spelling settled as fresh and senses spread to food, air, and energy.
items.cn: 拼写定型为 fresh，词义扩展到食物、空气与精力。

items.en: Compounds like fresh water, fresh air, and a fresh start became fixed.
items.cn: fresh water、fresh air、a fresh start 等搭配定型。

note.en: Words shaped like fresh and words about newness and coolness.
note.cn: 与 fresh 形近的词及表示新鲜、清凉的词。

entries.definition: the soft part of a body or fruit; differs from fresh by one letter
entries.definitionCN: 肉；果肉；与 fresh 仅一字母之差，读音也接近。

entries.definition: to give new energy; built on fresh with re-
entries.definitionCN: 使恢复精神；fresh 加 re- 构成。

entries.definition: goods carried by ship or truck; similar opening letters
entries.definitionCN: 货物；与 fresh 开头字母相近，词义无关。

entries.definition: recently made or arrived
entries.definitionCN: 新的；与 fresh 的「新近」义近义。

entries.definition: firm, fresh, and dry in a pleasant way
entries.definitionCN: 脆的；清爽的；描述新鲜口感的常用词。

entries.definition: cool and energizing, used of air or weather
entries.definitionCN: 凉爽提神的；书面语中形容清新空气。

normalIntro.en: Five hooks on dew, newness, and the main uses of fresh.
normalIntro.cn: 围绕露水、新近与 fresh 主要用法的五条记忆钩子。

normal.en: Fresh things still carry dew: just picked, just made.
normal.cn: fresh 的东西还挂着露水：刚摘、刚做。

normal.en: Fresh air is air no one has breathed out yet.
normal.cn: fresh air 就是还没有被人呼出过的空气。

normal.en: Fresh water is water the sea has not salted.
normal.cn: fresh water 是还没被海水腌过的水。

normal.en: A fresh face is one rested back to just-picked energy.
normal.cn: a fresh face 是休息后恢复「刚离枝」精神的脸。

normal.en: Watch the twin: fresh (new) versus flesh (soft body part).
normal.cn: 注意孪生词：fresh（新鲜）与 flesh（肉）。

abstract.en: Picture dew drops on a morning apple.
abstract.cn: 想象清晨苹果上的露珠。

abstract.en: Picture cold spring water rising from rocks.
abstract.cn: 想象从岩缝涌出的清凉泉水。

abstract.en: Picture a runner at dawn, fully rested.
abstract.cn: 想象清晨精神饱满起跑的选手。

examples.en: Grandma buys fresh fish at the harbour every Friday.
examples.cn: 奶奶每周五去码头买新鲜的鱼。

examples.en: Mountain villages are famous for their fresh air.
examples.cn: 山村里以清新的空气著称。

examples.en: The new term gives everyone a chance for a fresh start.
examples.cn: 新学期给了每个人一个新的开始。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「福来食」——福气随着现摘的食物一起来：fresh 就是刚摘下还带福气的食物。

root: fresh 出自日耳曼重构词根 *friskaz（鲜活的、带露的），古英语作 fersc（新鲜的、不咸的），古诺斯语 friskr 强化「有活力」义。核心意象是「带着露水离开源头」：新鲜、清新、淡水、精力饱满四义同源。

sensesIntro.en: Fresh runs from just-picked food to clean air, unsalted water, and rested energy.
sensesIntro.cn: fresh 从「刚摘下」的食物延伸到清新空气、淡水与恢复的精力。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: dew still on the thing just taken from its source
core.cn: 核心意象：刚离开源头之物上未干的露水

branches.en: Food close to its harvest moment
branches.cn: 离采摘时刻很近的食物

branches.en: Air and starts that feel unused
branches.cn: 像未用过一样的空气与开端

branches.en: Water that has never met salt
branches.cn: 从未与盐相遇的水

branches.en: Energy back to day-one level
branches.cn: 恢复到初始水平的精力

branches.en: Both food and people can feel just-picked
branches.cn: 食物与人都能呈现「刚离枝」的鲜活

intro.en: Fresh is a native root that still forms lively modern compounds.
intro.cn: fresh 是至今仍在造新词的本土词根。

latinIntro.en: The root is Germanic; Latin-based refresh is a hybrid of native fresh and Latin re-.
latinIntro.cn: 词根属日耳曼；refresh 是本土 fresh 与拉丁 re- 的混血构词。

items.meaning: a student in the first year

items.example: The flesh of the mango is sweet.

definition_zh: 冰箱；电冰箱（refrigerator 的口语缩略）
definition_en: a kitchen machine that keeps food cold so it stays fresh
core_image: 一台嗡嗡作响的白箱子：里面住着冬天
scene: 厨房里，妈妈打开那台白箱子，取出冷藏的牛奶。Milk should always be kept in the fridge.
sceneCN: 这里 fridge 是「冰箱」的意思（第 1 个义项：冷藏食物的电器）；牛奶要一直放在冰箱里保存。

collocations.phrase: take something out of the fridge

derivatives.zh: fridge 的完整正式说法，义为「冰箱；冷藏箱」
义为「冷藏；使变冷」
义为「制冷剂」
相关电器，义为「冰柜；冷冻箱」

senses.title: The kitchen cold machine
senses.definition: a powered kitchen cupboard that keeps food cold and fresh
senses.definitionCN: 带电的厨房柜子，使食物保持低温新鲜。
senses.example: There are two bottles of juice in the fridge.
senses.exampleCN: 冰箱里有两瓶果汁。
senses.why: The word is a clipped, friendly form of refrigerator.
senses.whyCN: 该词是 refrigerator 的截短、亲切化形式。

senses.title: The cold space itself
senses.definition: the cold inner space of the machine
senses.definitionCN: 冰箱内部的低温空间。
senses.example: The cake is inside the fridge, on the second shelf.
senses.exampleCN: 蛋糕在冰箱里，第二层。
senses.why: The machine name becomes the place name.
senses.whyCN: 机器名兼作容器名。

intro.en: Fridge is a playful clipping of the Latin-rooted word refrigerator.
intro.cn: fridge 是拉丁词源长词 refrigerator 的俏皮截短。

items.en: Refrigerare meant to make cool again, from frigus, cold.
items.cn: 拉丁语 refrigerare 意为「再次变凉」，词根 frigus 意为寒冷。

items.en: The word entered scientific English as refrigerate.
items.cn: 该词以 refrigerate 的形式进入科技英语。

items.en: Refrigerator named the household cold machine in the nineteenth century.
items.cn: 十九世纪 refrigerator 成为家用制冷设备的名称。

items.en: In the early twentieth century speakers clipped it to fridge, with a playful -dge ending.
items.cn: 二十世纪初，说话人把它截短为 fridge，用俏皮的 -dge 词尾。

items.en: Fridge became the everyday word while refrigerator stayed formal.
items.cn: fridge 成为日常用语，refrigerator 保留在正式场合。

note.en: Words shaped like fridge and words about cold storage.
note.cn: 与 fridge 形近的词及冷藏相关词。

entries.definition: a structure over a river; rhymes with fridge
entries.definitionCN: 桥；与 fridge 押韵且词尾相同。

entries.definition: the full machine with a frozen section
entries.definitionCN: 带冷冻柜的冰箱；fridge 的常见复合词。

entries.definition: a small decoration that sticks to the fridge
entries.definitionCN: 冰箱贴；常见复合词。

entries.definition: the full word for the same machine
entries.definitionCN: 冰箱（正式全称）。

entries.definition: a box that freezes food below zero
entries.definitionCN: 冰柜；冷冻箱；温度更低的食物保存设备。

entries.definition: a portable insulated box that keeps things cold
entries.definitionCN: 便携冷藏箱；无电源的野餐冷箱。

normalIntro.en: Five hooks on the clipped nickname and the cold space of fridge.
normalIntro.cn: 围绕截短昵称与冷藏空间的五条记忆钩子。

normal.en: Fridge is refrigerator's nickname: short and friendly.
normal.cn: fridge 是 refrigerator 的小名：短而亲切。

normal.en: Rhyme it with bridge: fridge, bridge — same ending.
normal.cn: 与 bridge 押韵记忆：fridge、bridge 同词尾。

normal.en: The fridge is the only place at home with winter inside.
normal.cn: 冰箱是家里唯一「装着冬天」的地方。

normal.en: Milk, eggs, and cake all sleep in the fridge.
normal.cn: 牛奶、鸡蛋、蛋糕都「睡」在冰箱里。

normal.en: Freezer keeps food frozen; fridge just keeps it cool.
normal.cn: freezer 冻硬食物；fridge 只是保持低温。

abstract.en: Picture a small white room full of winter.
abstract.cn: 想象一间装满冬天的小白屋。

abstract.en: Picture a humming box guarding cold milk.
abstract.cn: 想象嗡嗡作响、守护冷牛奶的箱子。

abstract.en: Picture a light turning on when the door opens.
abstract.cn: 想象开门时亮起的小灯。

examples.en: Put the leftover rice in the fridge or it will spoil.
examples.cn: 把剩饭放进冰箱，不然会变质。

examples.en: Our fridge is full before every big family dinner.
examples.cn: 每次家庭大餐前，我们的冰箱都塞得满满的。

examples.en: The fridge keeps vegetables fresh for days.
examples.cn: 冰箱能让蔬菜保鲜好几天。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「福瑞居」——食物有福气地住在凉爽的居所里：fridge 就是食物的清凉居所。

root: fridge 是 refrigerator 的口语截短形式；refrigerator 来自拉丁语 frigus（寒冷）+ refrigerare（再次变凉）。二十世纪初英语把长词裁短并加 -dge 词尾，制造出亲切的日常用语 fridge。

sensesIntro.en: Fridge names the cold machine and, by extension, its cold inner space.
sensesIntro.cn: fridge 命名制冷机器，并顺势兼指其内部的低温空间。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a humming white box with winter inside
core.cn: 核心意象：里面住着冬天的白色箱子

branches.en: The powered machine that cools food
branches.cn: 给食物降温的电器

branches.en: The everyday nickname of refrigerator
branches.cn: refrigerator 的日常昵称

branches.en: The cold inner space where food sleeps
branches.cn: 食物「安睡」的内部低温空间

branches.en: Second shelf, inside the fridge
branches.cn: 冰箱内第二层的具体位置

branches.en: From machine to place in one step
branches.cn: 从机器名到地点名的一步之遥

intro.en: Fridge is a clipped nickname, so its family lives in the full word refrigerator.
intro.cn: fridge 是截短昵称，其词族要在全称 refrigerator 中寻找。

latinIntro.en: The root is Latin frigus, cold, so the cognates are all Latin borrowings.
latinIntro.cn: 词根是拉丁语 frigus（寒冷），同源词都是拉丁借词。

items.example: Refrigerate the dough for an hour.
A big fridge freezer for the family.

definition_zh: 朋友；友人；支持者
definition_en: a person you know well and like, who is not part of your family
core_image: 并肩坐在同一张长椅上的两个人：愿意陪你的那个人
scene: 课间，小雨把新买的漫画递给同桌一起看。She shares everything with her best friend.
sceneCN: 这里 friend 是「朋友」的意思（第 1 个义项：彼此喜欢的人）；她把一切都与最好的朋友分享。

collocations.phrase: an old friend of the family

derivatives.zh: friend 加 -ly，义为「友好的」
friend 加 -ship，义为「友谊」
friend 加 -less，义为「没有朋友的」
be- + friend，义为「待人如友；照顾」

senses.title: A person you like and know well
senses.definition: someone you know well and like, outside your family
senses.definitionCN: 你熟悉并喜欢的人，不属于家人。
senses.example: A true friend listens when you are sad.
senses.exampleCN: 真正的朋友在你难过时会倾听。
senses.why: The root frijaz meant beloved: a friend is a chosen beloved.
senses.whyCN: 词根 frijaz 意为「亲爱的」：朋友是自己选的所爱之人。

senses.title: A supporter or helper
senses.definition: someone who supports a cause, group, or person
senses.definitionCN: 支持某项事业、组织或个人的人。
senses.example: The library has many friends who donate books.
senses.exampleCN: 图书馆有许多捐赠图书的支持者。
senses.why: The beloved circle widens to allies.
senses.whyCN: 「所爱圈子」扩大到同盟者。

intro.en: Friend shares its warm root with free: beloved membership in a circle.
intro.cn: friend 与 free 共享温暖词根：「圈子内被爱的成员」。

items.en: The root *frijaz meant beloved, connected with *frijo, love.
items.cn: 词根 *frijaz 意为亲爱的，与 *frijo（爱）相连。

items.en: Freond meant the loving one, the present participle of freon, to love.
items.cn: 古英语 freond 意为「爱着的人」，是动词 freon（爱）的现在分词。

items.en: Freond (friend) and freo (free) stayed close in sound and sense.
items.cn: freond（朋友）与 freo（自由）音义相近并存。

items.en: The vowel shortened to the modern sound, spelling settling as friend.
items.cn: 元音缩短，拼写定型为 friend。

items.en: The famous spelling rule 'i before e except after c' is broken by friend.
items.cn: friend 是著名拼写规则「i 在 e 前、c 后例外」的经典破例词。

note.en: Words shaped like friend and words about companionship.
note.cn: 与 friend 形近的词及表示陪伴的词。

entries.definition: the state of being friends
entries.definitionCN: 友谊；friend 加 -ship 构成。

entries.definition: an evil person; differs from friend by one letter
entries.definitionCN: 恶魔；与 friend 仅一字母之差，含义相反。

entries.definition: sudden fear; similar letters, different meaning
entries.definitionCN: 惊吓；字母相近但词义无关。

entries.definition: a person who spends time with you
entries.definitionCN: 同伴；强调共处时光。

entries.definition: a casual friend
entries.definitionCN: 伙伴；口语化的朋友说法。

entries.definition: a friend, especially among men
entries.definitionCN: 朋友（英式口语，多指男性之间）。

normalIntro.en: Five hooks on the beloved root, the spelling break, and friend uses.
normalIntro.cn: 围绕「所爱」词根、拼写破例与 friend 用法的五条记忆钩子。

normal.en: Friend and free share a root: the beloved ones are the free ones.
normal.cn: friend 与 free 同根：被爱的人即自由人。

normal.en: Remember the spelling: fri-END, a friend to the end.
normal.cn: 拼写口诀：fri-END，「有始有终」才是朋友。

normal.en: Friend breaks the i-before-e rule after f, not after c.
normal.cn: friend 在 f 后打破 i-before-e 规则（该规则只适用于 c 后例外）。

normal.en: Make friends with uses the plural: you join a pair, not one.
normal.cn: make friends with 用复数：加入的是「彼此」，不是单方。

normal.en: Fiend (devil) is friend without the r: missing r turns friend to fiend.
normal.cn: fiend（恶魔）比 friend 少一个 r：少了「关系」就成了恶魔。

abstract.en: Picture two friends sharing one long bench.
abstract.cn: 想象同坐一张长椅的两个朋友。

abstract.en: Picture an umbrella shared in the rain.

dict_mnemonic.text: 「福润德」——朋友如雨露润泽你的日子：friend 就是带来福润的人。

root: friend 出自古英语 freond，是动词 freon（爱）的现在分词「爱着的人」；词根 *frijaz（亲爱的）与 free 同源。核心意象是「自己选进所爱圈子里的人」；拼写 fri- + -end 是 i-before-e 规则的著名例外。

sensesIntro.en: Friend names the chosen beloved companion and, by extension, the supporter.
sensesIntro.cn: friend 命名亲手选定的挚爱伙伴，并延伸到支持者。

definition_zh: 友好的；亲切的；（关系）和睦的；（设备、政策）便于使用的；非正式比赛的；友军的
definition_en: kind and pleasant toward others, or designed to cause no difficulty
core_image: 清晨的院门口，主人把门闩拉开一半，站在门边等人走近，狗也没有叫
scene: 搬来第一天，隔壁的老人端着一盘刚烙的饼站在门口，狗摇着尾巴没有叫。The old woman next door came out with a plate of warm flatbread, and even the dog was friendly.
sceneCN: 这里 friendly 指「待人亲切、使人感到不受排斥」（第 1 个义项：对人温和有礼、乐于接近）；句意为隔壁老人端着热饼出来，连狗都很友善。可辨识物件：门槛、热饼、盘子、摇尾的狗。

pos.zh: 友好的；亲切的；和睦的；便于使用的；非正式的；友方的

derivatives.zh: 朋友（形容词的基础名词）
友善（friendly + -ness）
不友善的（un- + friendly）
以朋友之道对待

senses.title: Kind in the way you treat people
senses.definition: behaving in a warm and helpful way toward other people
senses.definitionCN: 以温和、乐于相助的方式对待他人
senses.example: The new neighbour was friendly from the first morning.
senses.exampleCN: 新邻居从第一个早晨就很亲切。
senses.why: The Old English adjective was built from friend plus a suffix meaning 'having the form of', so being friendly is literally looking and acting like a friend.
senses.whyCN: 这个古英语形容词由 friend 加表示「具有……形态」的后缀构成，因此友好字面上就是「像朋友那样待人」。

senses.title: Warm in appearance or atmosphere
senses.definition: looking welcoming rather than cold, formal or forbidding
senses.definitionCN: 看上去令人愿意走近，而非冷淡、拘谨或拒人于外
senses.example: The café had a friendly clutter of books and mugs.
senses.exampleCN: 那家咖啡馆堆着书和杯子，显得亲切随意。
senses.why: If a person can look like a friend, so can a room, and the adjective transfers to places that make people feel accepted.
senses.whyCN: 既然人可以看起来像朋友，房间也可以，于是这个形容词扩展到让人感到被接纳的场所。

senses.title: Cooperative between groups
senses.titleCN: 团体或国家之间和睦合作
senses.definition: not hostile and willing to work with another group or country
senses.definitionCN: 不怀敌意，愿意与另一团体或国家合作
senses.example: The two ports kept friendly relations through the dispute.
senses.exampleCN: 争端期间，两座港口城市仍保持友好关系。
senses.why: States borrow the personal adjective for relations that are peaceful without being formally allied.
senses.whyCN: 国家借用这个私人形容词，指和平共处但未正式结盟的关系。

senses.title: Easy to use or live with
senses.definition: designed or arranged so that it gives the user no trouble
senses.definitionCN: 经过设计或安排，使用起来不添麻烦
senses.example: The guide is written in friendly language for beginners.
senses.exampleCN: 这本指南用初学者也能亲近的语言写成。
senses.why: The modern sense takes the warmth of a helpful person and applies it to machines and policies that behave as if they wanted to help.
senses.whyCN: 现代义把助人者的温和，移用到那些表现得仿佛愿意帮忙的机器与政策上。

senses.title: Well disposed toward a plan
senses.definition: showing support or sympathy toward an idea, cause or proposal
senses.definitionCN: 对某个想法、事业或提议表示支持或同情
senses.example: The council was friendly to the idea of a night bus.
senses.exampleCN: 市议会对开设夜班公交的想法持赞许态度。
senses.why: Being friendly to a proposal is the political version of being friendly to a person: no hostility, an open door.
senses.whyCN: 对一项提议友好，是对人友好的政治版本：无敌意，门是开的。

senses.title: Sociable by nature, of animals
senses.definition: of an animal, inclined to approach people rather than avoid them
senses.definitionCN: 指动物愿意接近人而不是躲避人
senses.example: Their dog is friendly with every child on the street.
senses.exampleCN: 他们家的狗对街上每个孩子都很亲。
senses.why: The word describes temperament as well as behaviour, so an animal that seeks company is called friendly even when nobody is present.
senses.whyCN: 这个词既描述行为也描述性情，因此愿意亲近人的动物即使无人在场也被称为 friendly。

senses.title: Not counting toward a result
senses.definition: arranged for practice or goodwill rather than for a competitive result
senses.definitionCN: 为练习或友好而安排，不以竞赛结果为重
senses.example: They played a friendly before the league began.
senses.exampleCN: 联赛开始前他们踢了一场友谊赛。
senses.why: A match played in the spirit of friends is one whose score does not matter, so the adjective marks the absence of stakes.
senses.whyCN: 以朋友之道进行的比赛，比分并不重要，因此这个形容词标示「无关利害」。

senses.title: Of one's own side, by accident
senses.definition: belonging to one's own forces, used of accidental damage caused by them
senses.definitionCN: 属于己方部队，用于指己方造成的误伤
senses.example: Friendly fire damaged two of their own trucks.
senses.exampleCN: 友军火力误伤了他们自己的两辆卡车。
senses.why: The cruel irony is that fire from friends is still called friendly; the adjective marks the side, not the kindness.
senses.whyCN: 残酷的反讽在于，来自同伴的火力仍被称作「友方的」；这个形容词标的是阵营，不是善意。

intro.en: Friendly is an Old English adjective, freondlic, from freond 'friend' and -lic 'having the form or body of'. That suffix survives as modern -ly. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: friendly 是古英语形容词 freondlic，由 freond「朋友」与 -lic「具有……形态或形体」构成。这个后缀在现代英语中写作 -ly。下列年代均为约数。

items.en: The suffix -lic meant 'having the body or form of' and is the source of modern -ly; the adjective and the adverb both grew from it, which is why the two forms look alike.
items.cn: 后缀 -lic 意为「具有……形体或形态」，是现代 -ly 的来源；形容词与副词都由它生长出来，因此两种形式看起来一样。

items.en: Freondlic joined the noun for friend with that suffix to mean 'like a friend, kindly'. The compound is recorded in Old English, though no earliest citation can be dated exactly.
items.cn: freondlic 把表示朋友的名词与该后缀结合，意为「像朋友一样的、厚道的」。这一复合词在古英语中有书证，但最早一条无法定出确切年代。

items.en: Middle English kept the adjective and also formed a matching adverb from the same ending; the two were not separately invented, they simply parted company in use.
items.cn: 中古英语保留了这个形容词，同时用同一词尾构成对应的副词；两者并非各自新造，只是在用法上分了家。

items.en: From the nineteenth century the adjective was attached to nouns to mean 'causing no harm or difficulty', producing forms such as user-friendly and environment-friendly.
items.cn: 从十九世纪起，这个形容词被接到名词前，表示「不造成伤害或麻烦」，于是出现「对使用者友好」「对环境友好」这类说法。

items.en: Source uncertain (first date): the earliest recorded use of the Old English adjective cannot be dated with confidence, and the exact relation between the adjective and the adverb in early Middle English is still argued; the Germanic root behind friend is a reconstruction.
items.cn: 来源不确定（首见年代）：古英语形容词最早的书证无法确定年份；中古英语早期形容词与副词的确切关系仍有争论；friend 背后的日耳曼语词根属重构形式。

note.en: Group one holds the same-root family plus one near neighbour with an unrelated root; group two holds adjectives that describe a pleasant manner.
note.cn: 第一组是同根词族，外加一个字形相近却不同源的词；第二组是描述待人态度令人舒服的形容词。

entries.definition: The noun underneath the adjective; a friendly act is one a friend might do, while a friend is the person himself.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词底下的名词；friendly 的行为是朋友会做的事，而 friend 是那个人本身。

entries.definition: The quality formed with -ness; the adjective describes one act or mood, the noun names the lasting trait.
entries.definitionCN: 由 -ness 构成的品质名词；形容词描述一次行为或一时心境，名词指长期的性情。

entries.definition: Old English feond 'enemy'; nearly the same shape as friend, but there is no shared root, so the resemblance is a trap.
entries.definitionCN: 古英语 feond「敌人」；字形与 friend 几乎相同，词根却毫无关系，这种相似是个陷阱。

entries.definition: Un- plus friendly; it negates the manner but not necessarily the whole person, since a friendly person can have an unfriendly day.
entries.definitionCN: un- 加 friendly；它否定的是举止，不一定是整个人，因为一个友善的人也会有不友善的一天。

entries.definition: Formal and slightly old-fashioned: easy to like and pleasant to be with, describing disposition more than action.
entries.definitionCN: 正式且略显陈旧：讨人喜欢、相处舒服，更多描述性情而非具体行为。

entries.definition: Warm and sincere in a restrained, often official way, as in a cordial welcome; it is cooler than friendly in tone.
entries.definitionCN: 以克制、常带官方色彩的方式表达热情真诚，如「诚挚的欢迎」；语气比 friendly 更冷静。

entries.definition: Inclined to mix with others and enjoy their company; it describes the appetite for company rather than the treatment of it.
entries.definitionCN: 喜欢与人交往并享受共处；它描述对人群的喜好，而不是对待他人的方式。

entries.definition: Actively making a newcomer feel wanted; it focuses on the first moment of arrival, where friendly can describe a long habit.
entries.definitionCN: 主动让新来者感到被欢迎；它着眼于刚到场的那一刻，而 friendly 可以指长期的习惯。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: the real suffix history, the real compounds and the real pairings of the word.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的后缀演变、真实的复合词，以及这个词真实的搭配。

normal.en: The same ending that gives friendly also gives the adverb -ly, so the adjective and the adverb share one suffix.
normal.cn: 构成 friendly 的词尾同时也构成副词后缀 -ly，形容词与副词共用一个来源。

normal.en: Modern compounds are transparent: friendly to users, friendly to the environment, friendly to families.
normal.cn: 现代复合词一目了然：便于使用的、对环境友好的、适合家庭观看的。

normal.en: The word pairs with relations, atmosphere and terms: friendly relations, a friendly atmosphere, on friendly terms.
normal.cn: 这个词常与关系、气氛、相处状态搭配：友好关系、亲切气氛、关系和睦。

normal.en: Its opposite is simply unfriendly, with no separate root to learn.
normal.cn: 它的反义词只是加 un-，不必另记词根。

normal.en: In sport a friendly is a match whose result does not count, which is why the adjective can mean 'without stakes'.
normal.cn: 在体育中，friendly 指不计成绩的比赛，这解释了形容词为何能表示「无关利害」。

abstract.en: Picture a door left half open with a lamp still on behind it.
abstract.cn: 想象一扇门半开着，门后还亮着灯。

abstract.en: Picture a dog that wags instead of barks when a stranger reaches the gate.
abstract.cn: 想象陌生人走到门口时，狗摇尾巴而不是叫。

abstract.en: Picture a machine whose buttons are labelled in the order you would actually want to press them.
abstract.cn: 想象一台机器，按钮的排列正是你真正想按的顺序。

examples.en: A friendly librarian found him a desk when every seat was taken.
examples.cn: 所有座位都满了，一位友善的馆员还是给他找到一张桌子。

examples.en: The two committees have stayed friendly even when they disagreed.
examples.cn: 两个委员会即使意见相左，也一直保持友好。

examples.en: The village is not exactly beautiful, but it is friendly.
examples.cn: 这个村子算不上美，但待人亲切。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「friend（朋友）+ ly」——像朋友一样待人 → 友好的

root: 古英语 freond「朋友」+ -lic（「具有……形态」，今为 -ly）；friend 背后的日耳曼语词根属重构形式。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one gesture: a door left open. It starts with a person, moves to a room, then to relations between ports, then to tools and policies that behave as if they wanted to help, then to a friendly stance, a friendly animal, a match without stakes, and finally to fire from your own side.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项沿着同一个动作展开：一扇留开的门。它从一个人开始，移到一间屋子，再移到港口之间的关系，又移到那些仿佛愿意帮忙的工具与政策，然后是赞许的态度、亲人的动物、不计输赢的比赛，最后是来自己方的火力。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a door held half open, with a lamp behind it and no lock in sight.
core.cn: 核心意象：一扇半开的门，门后有灯，看不见锁。

branches.en: PERSON THEN PLACE: a person treats you like a friend, and then a room is arranged to feel the same.
branches.cn: 先人后屋：先是一个人把你当朋友对待，然后是一间屋子被布置成同样的感觉。

branches.en: PEACE WITHOUT STAKES: friendly relations between ports, and a match arranged so the score does not matter.
branches.cn: 不计利害的和睦：港口之间的友好关系，以及一场比分无关紧要的比赛。

branches.en: DESIGNED TO HELP: machines and policies that act as if they wanted to make your way easier.
branches.cn: 为人省事的设计：那些表现得仿佛愿意替你省力的机器与政策。

branches.en: AN OPEN STANCE: approval toward a proposal, and an animal that comes toward people rather than away.
branches.cn: 开放的姿态：对提议的赞许，以及主动靠近人而非躲开的动物。

branches.en: THE IRONIC SIDE: fire from your own side is still called friendly, because the word marks the camp and not the kindness.
branches.cn: 反讽的阵营：来自己方的火力仍被称作「友方的」，因为这个形容词标的是阵营，不是善意。

intro.en: Friendly shows the English suffix -ly at work twice: once as an adjective ending and once, in the adverb, as a manner ending.
intro.cn: friendly 展示了英语后缀 -ly 的两种工作方式：一次作形容词词尾，一次在副词中作方式词尾。

latinIntro.en: The word is Germanic, not Latin: friend plus the Old English suffix -lic, which became -ly.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词属日耳曼语而非拉丁语：friend 加古英语后缀 -lic，后者演变为 -ly。

items.example: The noun supplies the model the adjective imitates.
items.exampleCN: 名词提供了形容词所模仿的原型。

items.example: The suffix turns a person into a manner.
items.exampleCN: 这个后缀把人变成一种举止方式。

items.example: The old woman was friendly from the first morning.
items.exampleCN: 那位老人从第一个早晨就很亲切。

items.example: Friendliness costs nothing and opens most doors.
items.exampleCN: 友善不花钱，却能打开大多数门。

items.example: The clerk was efficient but unfriendly.
items.exampleCN: 那名职员效率很高，却不友善。

items.structure: user + friendly (compounded in the twentieth century)
items.example: The old software was powerful but never user-friendly.
items.exampleCN: 旧软件功能强大，却从不便于使用。

items.meaning: to act as a friend toward
items.example: She befriended the new pupil on his first day.
items.exampleCN: 新同学第一天她就与他结为朋友。

definition_zh: 友谊；朋友关系；友情；（团体、国家间的）友好关系
definition_en: the relationship between friends, based on mutual trust and goodwill
core_image: 两个孩子在院墙两边埋下同一颗种子，藤蔓翻过墙头缠在一起，谁也没有去剪断
scene: 两个邻村的少年各走一半的路，在界石旁交换午饭，谁也不欠谁。The two boys from rival villages met at the boundary stone each day and shared their lunches, and that friendship outlasted the quarrel between their families.
sceneCN: 这里 friendship 指「朋友之间彼此信任、互相往来的关系」（第 1 个义项：平等者之间长期自愿的友好关系）；句意为两个敌对村庄的少年每天在界石旁分吃午饭，这份友情比两家人的争吵更长久。可辨识物件：界石、饭盒、半旧书包、田埂。

pos.zh: 友谊；朋友关系；友情；（团体间的）友好关系

derivatives.zh: 友好的（friend + -ly）
友善（friendly + -ness）
以朋友之道相待（be- + friend）
解除好友关系（un- + friend）

senses.title: A bond two people keep choosing
senses.titleCN: 两人自愿维持的长期情谊
senses.definition: the warm, trusting relationship between people who choose each other's company
senses.definitionCN: 彼此选择对方作伴、相互信任的温暖关系
senses.example: Their friendship began in a shared dormitory and lasted fifty years.
senses.exampleCN: 他们的友谊始于同一间宿舍，持续了五十年。
senses.why: Old English built the word from friend plus -ship, a suffix for a state, so friendship is simply the condition of being friends.
senses.whyCN: 古英语用 friend 加表示状态的后缀构成这个词，因此友谊就是「作为朋友」的那种状态。

senses.title: The goodwill a friend carries
senses.definition: the affectionate goodwill that a friend feels and shows
senses.definitionCN: 朋友所怀有并表现出来的亲切善意
senses.example: He spoke of her with real friendship, not mere politeness.
senses.exampleCN: 他谈到她时带着真正的友情，而不只是客套。
senses.why: If friendship is a state, it can also be the feeling that maintains it, so the word names the warmth as well as the relation.
senses.whyCN: 如果说友谊是一种状态，它也可以指维持这种状态的情感，因此这个词既指关系，也指那份温情。

senses.title: The years a friendship lasts
senses.definition: the condition of being friends over a particular stretch of time
senses.definitionCN: 在某一特定时段内保持朋友关系的情形
senses.example: The friendship cooled after the business dispute.
senses.exampleCN: 那场生意纠纷之后，这份友谊冷了下来。
senses.why: The same noun covers the bond and its lifetime, since a relationship exists only as long as it is kept up.
senses.whyCN: 同一个名词既指情谊，也指它的存续期，因为关系只在被维持的期间内存在。

senses.title: Goodwill between groups or states
senses.titleCN: 团体或国家之间的友好关系
senses.definition: a cooperative relationship between organizations or countries that are not formally allied
senses.definitionCN: 未正式结盟的组织或国家之间的合作关系
senses.example: The two cities signed a friendship agreement in the town hall.
senses.exampleCN: 两座城市在市政厅签署了友好协议。
senses.why: Cities and states borrow the personal word for a link that is warmer than a treaty but less binding than an alliance.
senses.whyCN: 城市与国家借用这个私人词，指一种比条约更温和、比同盟更松散的联结。

senses.title: One friendship among many
senses.definition: a single instance of such a bond, countable and distinct from the rest
senses.definitionCN: 这种关系的一次具体实例，可数且与其余各段相区别
senses.example: She kept up friendships from every decade of her life.
senses.exampleCN: 她与人生每个十年里结识的朋友都保持着往来。
senses.why: Counting the word separates one particular bond from the general virtue, which is why the plural is so common.
senses.whyCN: 把词变成可数，就把某一段具体情谊与作为美德的友谊区分开来，因此复数形式极为常见。

senses.title: A link accepted on a screen
senses.titleCN: 社交平台上接受的好友关系
senses.definition: a connection accepted on a social platform that presents two users as friends
senses.definitionCN: 在社交平台上被接受、把两名用户呈现为好友的联结
senses.example: He accepted the friendship without ever meeting the man.
senses.exampleCN: 他接受了那条好友请求，却从未见过对方。
senses.why: Platforms needed a noun for the link itself, so they reused the oldest word for a bond and emptied it of time and trust.
senses.whyCN: 平台需要为这种联结找一个名词，于是动用了表示情谊的最古老的词，却抽掉了时间与信任。

senses.title: An alliance kept for advantage
senses.definition: a friendly arrangement maintained for gain rather than affection
senses.definitionCN: 出于得益而非情意维持的友好安排
senses.example: Their friendship was a friendship of convenience and both knew it.
senses.exampleCN: 他们的友情是彼此方便的结交，两边都心知肚明。
senses.why: Because the word promises trust, it can also be used ironically for a link that merely looks like trust.
senses.whyCN: 正因为这个词许诺信任，它也能反用来指一种只是看起来像信任的联结。

senses.title: Friendship as a thing to study
senses.titleCN: 被当作研究对象或德性的友谊
senses.definition: the virtue or social institution that philosophers and sociologists examine
senses.definitionCN: 哲学家与社会学家所考察的德性或社会制度
senses.example: The course reads ancient letters as evidence of how friendship was understood.
senses.exampleCN: 这门课把古代书信当作理解当时友谊观念的证据。
senses.why: Once a word names a relation, it can also name the thing itself as a topic, which is how friendship became a subject with a literature.
senses.whyCN: 一个词一旦指称某种关系，也能指称作为题目的事物本身，友谊由此成为有文献可查的课题。

intro.en: Friendship is an Old English compound of freond 'friend' and -scipe 'state, condition'. The noun for friend began as a participle of a verb meaning 'to love, to favour'. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: friendship 是古英语复合词，由 freond「朋友」与 -scipe「状态、身份」构成。friend 最初是表示「爱、眷顾」的动词的分词。下列年代均为约数。

items.en: Freond 'friend' continues a Germanic participle meaning 'loving, favouring', from a verb reconstructed as frijon 'to love'. The verb form is a reconstruction, not a recorded word.
items.cn: freond「朋友」承自一个意为「爱着、眷顾着」的日耳曼语分词，其动词被重构为 frijon「爱」；该动词形式属重构，并非有记录的词。

items.en: -scipe meant 'state, condition, office' and is the same suffix heard in lordship and hardship; it names what a person or thing is, not what they do.
items.cn: -scipe 意为「状态、身份、职位」，与 lordship、hardship 中的后缀相同；它指人或物「是什么」，而非「做什么」。

items.en: The compound is recorded in Old English for friendship or favour, but no single earliest citation can be dated precisely.
items.cn: 这一复合词在古英语中已用来指友谊或眷顾，但没有哪一条最早书证能定出确切年代。

items.en: Middle English carried the word through changes of spelling without changing its sense, and it remained the ordinary noun for the bond between friends.
items.cn: 中古英语在拼写变化中沿用这个词，词义未变，它始终是表示朋友间情谊的常用名词。

items.en: Source uncertain (deeper root and first date): the Germanic verb behind friend is reconstructed, its Indo-European ancestor is likewise a reconstruction, and the earliest Old English citation is not fixed with confidence.
items.cn: 来源不确定（更深词根与首见年代）：friend 背后的日耳曼语动词属重构，其印欧祖形同样是重构，古英语最早书证也无法确定年份。

note.en: Group one holds the same-root family and one near neighbour of a different root that is often mistaken for a relative; group two holds the words that describe closeness between people.
note.cn: 第一组是同根词族，外加一个常被误认作同族、实则不同源的近形词；第二组是描述人际亲近的近似词。

entries.definition: The noun inside the compound; it names the person, while friendship names the relationship between two such people.
entries.definitionCN: 复合词中的名词部分；它指人，而 friendship 指两个这样的人之间的关系。

entries.definition: The adjective built on friend with the old suffix for 'having the form of'; it describes behaviour, not the bond itself.
entries.definitionCN: 由 friend 加表示「具有……形态」的旧后缀构成的形容词；它描述行为，而非关系本身。

entries.definition: Old English feond meant 'enemy'; the shape is close to friend but the roots are unrelated, which is why the pair is a trap.
entries.definitionCN: 古英语 feond 意为「敌人」；字形与 friend 相近，词根却毫无关系，因此这一对极易误认。

entries.definition: Un- plus friend, formed in the age of social platforms for removing a name from a list; it is not an old word.
entries.definitionCN: 由 un- 加 friend，在社交平台时代才出现，指把某人移出好友名单；它不是古老词。

entries.definition: The state of having someone beside you; it stresses presence and shared hours rather than the affection friendship implies.
entries.definitionCN: 身边有人的状态；它强调在场与共处的时间，而非 friendship 所含的情意。

entries.definition: The closeness of people who work or fight together; it rests on a common task, while friendship rests on choice.
entries.definitionCN: 一同工作或战斗的人之间的亲近；它依托共同任务，而友谊依托彼此选择。

entries.definition: Any strong link between people, including family and colleagues; it is broader and often more physical in feel.
entries.definitionCN: 人与人之间的任何强烈联结，包括家人与同事；含义更宽，感觉上常更具体。

entries.definition: A formal union of parties for a purpose; it is political or strategic, and carries none of the warmth of friendship.
entries.definitionCN: 各方为某目的结成的正式联合；它是政治或策略性的，不含友谊的温情。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: the real Old English parts, the real suffix family and the real verbs that pair with the noun.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实存在的古英语构词成分、真实的后缀词族，以及真实与这个名词搭配的动词。

normal.en: The suffix is the one heard in lordship and hardship: a state or condition, here the state of being a friend.
normal.cn: 这个后缀也出现在 lordship 与 hardship 中：表状态或身份，此处即「身为朋友」的状态。

normal.en: Friend began as a participle meaning 'loving', so friendship is literally the condition of one who loves.
normal.cn: friend 原为意为「爱着」的分词，所以友谊字面上就是「爱着的人所处的状态」。

normal.en: The noun takes real verbs: form a friendship, strike up a friendship, keep up a friendship, break off a friendship.
normal.cn: 这个名词有真实动词搭配：建立友谊、结下友谊、维持友谊、断绝友谊。

normal.en: Its adjective is friendly and its abstract quality is friendliness, both built with ordinary English endings.
normal.cn: 它的形容词是 friendly，抽象性质是 friendliness，两者都用普通英语词尾构成。

normal.en: Companionship is the nearest rival, but it counts hours together, while friendship counts affection.
normal.cn: 最接近的是 companionship，但它算的是共处的时间，而 friendship 算的是情意。

abstract.en: Picture a vine crossing a wall because two children planted the same seed on both sides.
abstract.cn: 想象一株藤蔓翻过院墙，因为两个孩子在墙两边种下了同一颗种子。

abstract.en: Picture two chairs left outside overnight, neither moved, both damp with the same rain.
abstract.cn: 想象两把椅子整夜放在户外，谁也没搬动，被同一场雨同时打湿。

abstract.en: Picture a debt between two people that neither of them ever tries to settle.
abstract.cn: 想象两个人之间的一笔账，谁也从不去结清。

examples.en: Their friendship survived a year of silence and two arguments about money.
examples.cn: 他们的友谊熬过了一年的沉默与两次关于钱的争吵。

examples.en: The school pairs older pupils with younger ones to build friendships across year groups.
examples.cn: 学校让高年级学生与低年级学生结对，以跨年级建立友谊。

examples.en: The two ports have kept a friendship agreement since the war ended.
examples.cn: 战争结束后，两座港口城市一直维持着友好协议。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「friend（朋友）+ ship（船）」——同坐一条船的朋友 → 友谊

root: 古英语 freond「朋友」+ -scipe「状态、身份」；freond 原为「爱、眷顾」动词的分词，该日耳曼语动词与印欧祖形均属重构形式。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one chosen bond: two people keep choosing each other, the goodwill they carry, the years it lasts, the goodwill between cities, single instances of it, a link accepted on a screen, a bargain dressed as affection, and the thing philosophers study.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项沿着同一份自愿的情谊展开：两人不断重新选择对方、心中所怀的善意、情谊存续的岁月、城市之间的友好、若干段中的一段、屏幕上接受的联结、披着情意的利益结交，最后是被当作课题来研究的友谊。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a vine grown from one seed on two sides of a wall, never cut where it crosses.
core.cn: 核心意象：一颗种子在墙两边长出的同一株藤，越过墙头处从未被剪断。

branches.en: PERSONAL BOND IN TIME: the relationship itself and the stretch of years through which it is kept up.
branches.cn: 私人情谊及其岁月：关系本身，以及维持这段关系的那些年头。

branches.en: THE FEELING INSIDE IT: goodwill is what keeps the state alive from day to day.
branches.cn: 关系中的情感：善意是让这种状态逐日存活的东西。

branches.en: BETWEEN BODIES: cities and states borrow the personal word for cooperation without a treaty.
branches.cn: 团体之间：城市与国家借用这个私人词，指不签条约的合作。

branches.en: COUNTED AND BARGAINED: one friendship among many, and the ironic version kept only for advantage.
branches.cn: 可数者与交易者：若干段中的一段，以及只为利益而维持的那种反用。

branches.en: SCREEN AND STUDY: a link emptied of time, and the bond turned into a subject with a literature.
branches.cn: 屏幕与学问：被抽掉时间的联结，以及成为有文献之课题的情谊。

intro.en: Friendship is a Germanic compound whose two parts still work separately in English, so the whole family reads clearly.
intro.cn: friendship 是日耳曼语复合词，两部分在英语中仍各自独立运作，因此整个词族都能读得清楚。

latinIntro.en: The word has no Latin root: friend and -ship are both Germanic, and the suffix is still productive in modern English.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词没有拉丁词根：friend 与 -ship 都属日耳曼语，而这个后缀在现代英语中仍有构词能力。

items.example: The first element names the person who loves.
items.exampleCN: 第一个成分指怀着爱意的那个人。

items.example: The suffix turns a person into a relationship.
items.exampleCN: 这个后缀把人变成一种关系。
他们的友谊持续了五十年。

items.example: The new neighbour was friendly from the first morning.
items.exampleCN: 新邻居从第一个早晨就很友善。

items.example: Her friendliness made the office easier to enter.
items.exampleCN: 她的友善让这间办公室更容易走进。

items.meaning: to act as a friend toward someone
items.example: A retired teacher befriended the boy.
items.exampleCN: 一位退休教师与那男孩结为朋友。

items.meaning: to remove someone from a list of friends
items.example: He unfriended her after the argument.
items.exampleCN: 争吵之后他把她删除了好友。

items.example: The first term left him friendless in a new city.
items.exampleCN: 第一个学期让他在新城市里没有朋友。
